role: Exploratory campaign diagnosis, not a gene promotion batch
observation: After each seat turn, inspect current Conquest plan and its still-owned foreign objective. Walled means actual wall_hp > 0; these are diagnostic world observations, not additional information supplied to the AI. Near means hex distance <= 6, not a path-feasibility or firing-range claim. Totals count observations, not unique cities or independent samples.

paired_research_trace.definition: Selected research plus known technology set, every major at every observed turn start; treatment enables domination-siege-research, control disables it.

reproduction: Check out source_commit; build the developer-tools library with cargo build --profile ci --locked --features developer-tools --lib. Extract observer_rust_source to a temporary .rs file and compile with rustc --edition=2021 -O --extern civvis=<that build rlib> -L dependency=target/ci/deps. Run from the checked-out repository. END records contain raw engine turn, not reported_turn().

protocol.shape: 3p36x22Online250, no city-states/barbs, all majors targeting Domination
protocol.primary: fraction of worlds ending in Domination; paired terminal outcomes
protocol.secondary: post-turn walled Conquest observations, fielded/queued land siege gap, distance <=6 proximity
protocol.limitations: Symmetric-lane completion, not observed-player competitive win rate; no default promotion from this batch; follow-up selected after eight-seed exploratory delivery census; seeds disjoint from exploration.

commitment_holdout.interpretation: The disjoint holdout does not support enabling siege commitment for this configuration. Counts are symmetric world completion, not one treated player winning; observation totals are not independent samples. No deployment/default changes.
